title: Fold a NOT READY review's blocking findings that share a seam into one tick
body:
The run makes one tick per blocking finding. v5t's round-1 review named two findings on ONE seam (the claude-sub step-down, Go side and TS side); they became y38 and yhe in parallel, needed a resolve-conflict job on internal/exec/cloudflaresandbox/model_test.go, and yhe filed a duplicate HIGH finding (bw7) for the defect y38 had just fixed, which then needed o3f to close it. 2jn paid the same shape at 16 ticks and 7 resolves. The learning 'fold by seam' exists but nothing applies it mechanically: the run should group a NOT READY's blocking findings whose evidence names overlapping files (or packages on both sides of one contract) into one tick, or at least serialize them.
evidence: .ticfac/runs/epic-v5t/decisions/7.json (two blocking findings); decisions/10.json (resolve of model_test.go between yhe and y38); .tick/issues/bw7.json, o3f.json
